snippet.title: Golf 5 Playoff Edition - Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
VR Golf: Step onto the Green in Golf 5 "Playoff Edition" Update – November 13, 2025

Get ready to tee off in the most realistic VR golf game! Golf 5 "Playoff Edition" update is swinging onto Meta Quest, SteamVR, and Pico 4 on November 13, 2025. Experience new gameplay modes, like Flash 3 Holes, Scramble, and Fourball, alongside stunning visual enhancements to your favorite courses.

Master your swing with true-to-life High Precision Control Physics, track your shots with the XTi© Pro Launch Manager, and compete online in 1v1 or team formats. Plus, enjoy dozens of quality-of-life updates.

Don't miss out on Golf 5!
